meta.title: STRIKEBULL MMA Club Chur – MMA, Boxing, Muay Thai, BJJ & Wrestling
meta.description: MMA training in Chur for beginners and advanced athletes: boxing, Muay Thai, BJJ and wrestling. Every Tuesday and Friday. Your first 2 trial sessions are free.

hero.lead: MMA, boxing, Muay Thai, BJJ and wrestling in Chur – for beginners and advanced athletes. Your first two sessions are free.

about.label: About us
about.title: A club for everyone who wants more
about.p1: STRIKEBULL is a new MMA club in Chur. Beginners, hobby athletes and competitors train side by side – with respect, discipline and a lot of fun.
about.p2: Whether you want to get fitter, learn to defend yourself or step into the ring: we meet you where you are. No experience needed – just the will to work on yourself.

disciplines.label: Training
disciplines.title: What you'll learn
disciplines.intro: MMA combines the best of stand-up and ground fighting. With us, you train both.

items.title: Boxing & Muay Thai
items.text: Punches, kicks, knees and elbows. You learn clean technique, distance control and combinations – and get in great shape along the way.

items.title: BJJ & Wrestling
items.text: Takedowns, ground control and submissions. Technique beats strength here – ideal for lighter athletes too.

items.title: All together
items.text: We combine stand-up and ground fighting into one complete system – for self-defence, fitness or the path to competition.

items.title: Experienced coach
items.text: Coaching since 2014 – you learn the right technique from day one.

items.title: Every level
items.text: Beginners and advanced athletes train together, each at their own pace.

items.title: Safety first
items.text: Controlled sparring, protective gear and clear rules.

items.title: Strong team
items.text: You never train alone. We push each other – on and off the mat.

schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.title: Twice a week. Every week.
schedule.note: Come 10 minutes early so you have time to get changed.

coach.label: Coach
coach.title: Your coach
coach.name: Dmytro Chernenko
coach.text: Dmytro has been coaching fighters of every level since 2014 – from their very first session all the way to competition. He puts great emphasis on clean technique, discipline and an atmosphere where everyone feels welcome.

prices.label: Prices
prices.title: Start risk-free
prices.intro: Your first two sessions are free and without obligation. After that, choose what suits you.

items.q: Do I need my own gear?
